title: 第五章 斗石！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你刚才挑的原石，第一块就出了许多高价值的阳绿，光这一笔价值就上百万，再加上其他翡翠，价值已经快达到两百万，不过我们得去除雕刻费用，包装费用，宣传费用，算下来，净利润在百万左右，按照合同，你得三成，那就是三十万。”

叶凡心中兴奋。

三十万这就到手了！

当然，面上叶凡很平静，点头道，“谢谢陈总。”

看到叶凡表情，陈若彤美眸一闪，但她没多说，点头道，“好，接下来你是打算回去休息，还是继续在大会买石？”

“继续。”

叶凡道，“今天是泉城珠宝行业的一次聚会，是难得的机会，当然要多赚一些。”

“好，这次我和你一起去。”陈若彤一笑，和叶凡一起离开茶室。

到了一楼会场，叶凡运转望气术，看向四周。

很快，他又找到七八块蕴含高价值翡翠的原石，对陈若彤说了。

陈若彤干脆买下，送到二楼让人解石。

结果全都大赚！

陈若彤自然心惊！

“看来我这次是捡到宝了！就这眼力，不要太久，他就会成为我盛宝楼的摇钱树！”

心中暗想，陈若彤对叶凡越发重视。

“嗯？若晴，我正找你呢，没想到你在这。”

笑声传出，叶凡一愣，看向左侧。

一个身穿蓝色西装，身材挺拔的青年走过来。

“是你，杨旭。”

看到这青年，陈若彤眼睛一眯，眸中划过一道厌恶。

“呵呵，若彤，刚才我一直在找你，没想到你在这，怎么，你是来练眼力的？不过这没好东西吧，好东西都被他们藏起来了，哪会拿出来？”

似乎没看出陈若彤眼中厌恶，杨旭笑了声。

“再小的机会也是机会，虽这里有价值的原石不多，但不代表完全没有。”

陈若彤淡淡道。

“哦？呵呵，看来若彤是捡到漏了？那能不能让我涨涨见识？”

杨旭又一笑，一边笑，他还一边靠近陈若彤。

Page (1/3)

"The first piece of the rough stone you picked just now contains a lot of high-value sun green. This alone is worth millions. Add in other jadeite, and the value has almost reached two million. However, we have to deduct the engraving costs, packaging costs, and publicity costs. After calculation, the net profit is around one million. According to the contract, you get 30%, which is three hundred thousand."

Ye Fan was excited.

Three hundred thousand is now available!

Of course, Ye Fan looked very calm and nodded, "Thank you, Mr. Chen."

Seeing Ye Fan's expression, Chen Ruotong's beautiful eyes flashed, but she didn't say much, nodded and said, "Okay, do you plan to go back to rest next, or continue to buy stones at the conference?"

"Continue."

Ye Fan said, "Today is a gathering of the jewelry industry in Quancheng. It is a rare opportunity. Of course, we must make more money."

"Okay, I'll go with you this time." Chen Ruotong smiled and left the tea room with Ye Fan.

When he arrived at the venue on the first floor, Ye Fan used his qi-gazing technique and looked around.

Soon, he found seven or eight more rough stones containing high-value jadeite and told Chen Ruotong.

Chen Ruotong simply bought it and sent it to the second floor for people to interpret the stone.

The result is huge profits!

Chen Ruotong was naturally shocked!

"It seems that I have found a treasure this time! With my eyesight, it won't take long, and he will become a cash cow for my Shengbao Tower!"

Thought to himself, Chen Ruotong paid more and more attention to Mark.

"Huh? Ruoqing, I was looking for you, but I didn't expect you to be here."

Laughter came out, Ye Fan was stunned and looked to the left.

A tall and tall young man wearing a blue suit came over.

"It's you, Yang Xu."

Seeing this young man, Chen Ruotong narrowed his eyes, and a trace of disgust flashed in his eyes.

"Haha, Ruotong, I have been looking for you just now, but I didn't expect you to be here. Why, are you here to practice your eyesight? But this is not a good thing, right? The good things have been hidden by them, how can you take them out?"

Yang Xu laughed as he didn't seem to see the disgust in Chen Ruotong's eyes.

"No matter how small the opportunity is, it is still an opportunity. Although there are not many valuable rough stones here, it does not mean that there are none."

Chen Ruotong said calmly.

"Oh? Haha, it seems that Ruotong picked it up and missed it? Can that help me gain some knowledge?"

Yang Xu smiled again, and while laughing, he got closer to Chen Ruotong.
